title: RAW exact calculus and actual joint quotient lifting
scope: A bounded Foundations I module, not the whole foundations or any application. One-original-sort specializations are marked explicitly. No Lean code or compiled provider imports.

assumptions.name: Original represented typed CCO source
assumptions.statement: Source homogeneity, named original-sort transitivity, finite complete binary language and semantic homomorphic CCO are explicit premises, not consequences of the sidecar graph. Standard classical finite/countable reasoning is used. No external EPPA, Ramsey, factorization-forest or coset-cover theorem is imported.

definitions.name: Typed source
definitions.statement: Finite named inhabited sorts; countable total universe; finite complete binary relational language; homogeneous original source and transitive original sorts; symmetric same-sort diversity and converse-paired cross-sort atoms; typed semantic homomorphic CCO. No SAP or infinitude assumption.

source.anchor: The following common statement also applies

definitions.name: Invariant represented relation and atom
definitions.statement: A typed relation is an actual subset of N_i × N_j. Invariant means preserved by every original automorphism. An atom is one actual ordered-pair orbit, including logical Id_i on loop sorts.

definitions.name: Represented composition and converse
definitions.statement: (R;S)(x,z) iff ∃y, R(x,y) ∧ S(y,z); Rᵒᵖ(y,x) iff R(x,y). Witnesses may repeat endpoints. Top_ij=N_i×N_j.

definitions.name: Typed word and profile
definitions.statement: A finite typed composable atomic word evaluates to its actual walk endpoint relation. The empty word exists only at one sort and evaluates to logical Id.

definitions.name: Exact presentation and nonempty exact relation
definitions.statement: A finite list of same-endpoint typed words evaluates to the intersection of their profiles. Empty list evaluates to typed Top. A nonempty exact relation includes a proof that this evaluation is nonempty; meet closure requires nonempty RESULT.

definitions.name: Typed partial diagram and CCO
definitions.statement: A finite simple typed graph with one specified diversity atom per specified edge. Cycle tests are homomorphisms of each specified simple cycle. CCO supplies a homomorphism of the whole diagram; unspecified pairs may collapse.

definitions.name: Exact ball
definitions.statement: For D:u→t and b∈N_t, B_D(b)={z∈N_u : D(z,b)}. A family may repeat the same centre value under different constraints.

definitions.name: Actual quotient family
definitions.statement: For each original sort s choose finitely many actual invariant full exact equivalences J, including Id_s. Sorts N_s/J are tagged actual quotient carriers; N_s/Id_s is identified with N_s.

definitions.name: Full quotient orbital language
definitions.statement: Name every actual Aut(N) ordered-pair orbit between chosen quotient sorts. Logical equality remains logical, and each same-sort diagonal is retained in pair-orbit bookkeeping.

definitions.name: Finite joint partial isomorphism
definitions.statement: A sort-preserving injective finite partial map of the tagged displayed sorts preserving all their binary orbitals; domains need not include real representatives of displayed classes.

definitions.name: Actual equivariant unary enrichment
definitions.statement: A finite family of actual unary functions between already displayed sorts satisfying τ(gq)=gτ(q) for every original g∈Aut(N). The source corollary uses finite functionally closed domains.

claims.name: Orbital uniformity and seriality
claims.statement: Every nonempty invariant typed relation contains an atom and is serial and coserial at EVERY endpoint point. Named atoms equal actual pair orbits.

claims.name: Typed relation algebra and top
claims.statement: Composition is associative, invariant and monotone, reverses under converse and has logical identities as units. Compatible nonempty invariant products are nonempty. Typed Top absorbs every compatible nonempty invariant factor.

claims.name: Atomic typed Peirce
claims.statement: For atoms a:i→j and c:i→k and invariant B:j→k: c⊆a;B iff a∩(c;Bᵒᵖ)≠∅. More generally replace a by an invariant A.

claims.name: Original symmetric commutation and equivalence joins
claims.statement: All original invariant binary relations commute. For invariant equivalences E,H, E;H=E∨H. This statement does not assert mixed-original-sort commutativity.

claims.name: Word evaluation and equality normalization
claims.statement: Profile evaluation equals word-walk existence; deleting identity letters preserves it; empty word gives Id; concatenation gives composition; reversed converse word gives converse.

claims.name: Theta construction and cycle witnesses
claims.statement: For finitely many nonempty pairwise-intersecting profiles presented by reduced words of positive length and one endpoint type, build private paths, merge equal direct edges, and show every simple cycle is two private paths with a homomorphism into N.

claims.name: Word-profile Helly
claims.statement: Every finite pairwise-intersecting family of nonempty same-endpoint word profiles has nonempty total intersection; the empty family evaluates to inhabited Top.

claims.name: Exact Helly and presentation closure
claims.statement: Flatten presentations to obtain 2-Helly for nonempty exact menus; reversal gives converse closure; concatenating lists gives closure under meets with nonempty result.

claims.name: Exact convolution
claims.statement: For nonempty D=⋂α Pα:i→j and F=⋂β Qβ:j→k, D;F=⋂αβ(Pα;Qβ). Empty restriction lists are treated by top absorption. The product is nonempty and exact.

claims.name: Nonempty-result meet distribution and saturation
claims.statement: Composition by a fixed NONEMPTY EXACT factor distributes in either argument over finite exact meets whose result is nonempty. For exact equivalences E,H and D=⋂r Dr≠∅, E;D;H=⋂r(E;Dr;H), including the empty list/top case.

claims.name: Ball pair criterion
claims.statement: For arbitrary typed D:u→t,F:u→s and actual centres b,c, B_D(b)∩B_F(c)≠∅ iff (b,c)∈Dᵒᵖ;F.

claims.name: Anchored fan construction and cycle witnesses
claims.statement: After handling reduced-empty-word identity restrictions directly, a finite pairwise-intersecting exact-ball family has a valid private-path diagram with a complete actual centre diagram; each cycle has a homomorphism, including same-menu and repeated-centre cases.

claims.name: Heterogeneous exact-ball Helly
claims.statement: Every finite pairwise-intersecting family of nonempty exact balls with one target original sort and arbitrary original centre sorts has a common point, including empty/singleton families and repeated centres. CCO plus homogeneity aligns its complete centre diagram.

claims.name: Actual quotient orbital pullback and saturation
claims.statement: The pullback of the actual pair orbit of ([x]_J,[y]_K), for original atom a=orb(x,y), is J;a;K; it is saturated and invariant. For exact J,K it is nonempty exact. Invariant saturated relations descend to unions of quotient pair orbits.

claims.name: Fine-colour reconstruction
claims.statement: For m≥1 exact equivalences E_i and K=⋂i E_i, ⋂i(E_i;a;E_i)=K;a;K for every original atom a including Id. The K pair orbit is determined by projected E_i pair orbits. No arbitrary tuple realization is asserted.

claims.name: Mixed join reduction
claims.statement: For exact invariant E,H with J=E∨H, E;a;H=J;a;J=J;a. Two within-sort partial maps preserve mixed orbitals if ONE partial isomorphism on their common J-quotient covers both projected domains and agrees with both. The algebra itself needs no exactness.

claims.name: Nested mixed reduction
claims.statement: If J≤K, J;a;K=K;a;K=a;K. A J-partial map p and K-partial map γ preserve all mixed orbitals if every projected J-domain point lies in dom(γ) and π(p(q))=γ(π(q)) for each q∈dom(p).

claims.name: Representative-independent cycle expansion
claims.statement: Given a typed cycle homomorphism (or an instance of one nonempty edge orbital), every choice of real marked representatives admits all private word walks for the corresponding edge pullbacks simultaneously.

claims.name: Real-to-quotient request relation
claims.statement: For x∈N_u, d=[c]_J and a=orb(x,c), D=a;J is the full pullback of orb(x,d), nonempty full exact and right J-saturated; every target representative gives the same orbital constraint.

claims.name: Finite joint one-real-point extension
claims.statement: Every finite joint partial isomorphism can be extended to include any original real point in its domain, preserving all pair orbitals and injectivity; use pairwise ambient orbit transport and exact-ball Helly.

claims.name: Back-and-forth with quotient anchors
claims.statement: Alternating C20 for a map and its inverse over all original real points yields one original automorphism inducing the whole initial finite joint partial isomorphism. Class membership orbitals anchor the initially displayed quotient parameters.

claims.name: Equivariant unary enrichment
claims.statement: Every isomorphism of finite functionally closed induced substructures of the actual equivariant unary enrichment extends to one induced original automorphism.

claims.name: One-sort joint specialization
claims.statement: Every finite joint partial isomorphism of the chosen real/exact quotient sorts is induced by one original automorphism, without SAP or a coherent choice of lifts.

claims.name: Triangle fullness of actual exact quotient age
claims.statement: Every finite complete typed diagram whose induced diagrams on at most three vertices are in the actual quotient age is realized there. Use invariant saturated products to transfer triangle witnesses to previously chosen representatives and ball Helly to add a class.

claims.name: AP of actual quotient age
claims.statement: Align two finite quotient-age embeddings over their common induced base using joint homogeneity, then take their finite induced union. Identifications outside the base are permitted.

claims.name: Private-path quotient cycle classification
claims.statement: Replace typed edges by exact word paths, discard top presentations, suppress identity letters, exclude identity-only edge restrictions and merge equal direct edges. Each raw simple cycle is two paths for one edge or projects to a specified simple typed cycle.

claims.name: Semantic CCO of actual quotient age
claims.statement: Cycle witnesses from C18 and C26 permit original CCO to complete the expanded diagram; projecting marked images gives a typed quotient homomorphism.

claims.name: Inherited single-quotient source properties
claims.statement: Each actual exact quotient is countable, nonempty and transitive with finite complete symmetric orbital language; joint homogeneity, C24, C25 and C27 supply homogeneity, triangle fullness, AP and semantic CCO.

controls.check: Represented four-point F2² translation source: exact product closure, nonempty-result meet distribution, exact-menu Helly and exact-ball Helly.
Invariant nonexact three-ball counterexample; empty-result saturation counterexample; invalid nonempty-indexed meet closure.
Two tagged copies of a three-point set: typed converse orientation and heterogeneous ball criterion. An algebra control, not a CCO assertion.
Three nonexact line quotients of the F2² translation source admit a joint binary orbital automorphism with no ambient original lift.
Finite 3×3 grid: exact coordinate equivalences are represented squares, and their pair orbitals reconstruct the fine colour. No CCO assertion about this finite grid.

tasks.acceptance: Choose and compile typed carriers, invariant pair relations, atom-support correspondence and exact presentations.

tasks.name: Finite private-path combinatorics
tasks.acceptance: Implement simple finite graph paths with private interiors, duplicate direct-edge merging and generic theta/fan/cycle classification templates. Quotient instantiations belong to T06.

tasks.name: RAW exact calculus
tasks.acceptance: Formalize semantic CCO uses and nonempty-result distribution; do not take Helly as an extra source axiom.

tasks.name: Actual quotient orbital geometry
tasks.acceptance: Implement actual quotient actions and orbital pullbacks; prove colour reconstruction and mixed joins independently of joint homogeneity.

tasks.name: Joint finite-map lifting
tasks.acceptance: Implement the finite joint extension and countable back-and-forth with the persistent quotient anchors.

tasks.name: Quotient-age inheritance
tasks.acceptance: Assemble triangle fullness, AP and semantic CCO, retaining their separate proof routes.

article_feedback.finding: Read nonempty meets as meets with nonempty result, not merely a nonempty index set.
article_feedback.proposed_article_change: Replace by closed under meets with nonempty intersection if the surrounding notation does not already make this explicit.
article_feedback.caller_effect: No mathematical change: product and saturation proofs already require nonempty evaluated intersections.

article_feedback.finding: Propagation from one witnessed representative pair to an entire quotient pair orbit uses invariance together with saturation. Both hold for the product.
article_feedback.proposed_article_change: Optionally add invariant before saturated in the triangle-fullness proof.
article_feedback.caller_effect: No strengthened hypothesis or changed conclusion.

article_feedback.finding: Legal finite complete typed diagrams must include legal subdiagrams on at most three vertices, covering 0/1/2-vertex boundary cases.
article_feedback.proposed_article_change: State the at-most-three-vertices convention once in the human setting if needed.
article_feedback.caller_effect: No change to the age or any caller.

review.method: Parent mathematical expansion plus two independent read-only model reviews of RAW and quotient/lifting branches. Not an independent human certificate or Lean proof.
review.remaining: Finite graph constructions, quotient encodings and countable back-and-forth still have to be implemented and proved in Lean; no library API compatibility has been compiled.
